uncited: Viewpoint Saliency is a metric used to select optimal viewpoints for volume visualization by maximizing the visible importance of the data.
It builds on [Visibility-Weighted Saliency](6824-visibility-weighted-saliency.md) by aggregating voxel-level saliency scores weighted by their visibility from a specific camera position.
- A set of candidate viewpoints $V_{cand}$.
- A precomputed saliency value $S(p)$ for every voxel $p$ in the volume dataset.
- A visibility function $V(p, v)$ that determines if voxel $p$ is visible from viewpoint $v$.
- The viewpoint $v^*$ that maximizes the total visible saliency.
This typically involves ray casting or depth buffer analysis to check if $p$ is occluded by other voxels closer to the camera.
Add the weighted saliency to the total: $S(v) \leftarrow S(v) + S(p) \times V(p, v)$.
Select the viewpoint $v^*$ with the maximum $S(v)$.
- $P$ is the set of voxels of the volume data.
- Saliency computation parameters (e.g., for mesh or voxel-based saliency): Not given in the sources.
- Visibility threshold: Not given in the sources.
- **Occlusion:** If $V(p)$ is strictly binary, small misalignments in ray casting may cause flickering or incorrect visibility.
- **Saliency Definition:** The source references [LVJ05] for mesh saliency but does not specify the exact voxel saliency algorithm used.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(|V_{cand}| \cdot |P|)$ if visibility is checked per voxel.
This is computationally expensive for large volumes.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(|P|)$ to store voxel saliency values.
- **Limitations:** Requires precomputed voxel saliency; visibility calculation can be slow; sensitive to the accuracy of the visibility function.
- **When to use:** When the goal is to automatically generate views that highlight the most "important" or distinct features of a volume.
- **When not to use:** When real-time interaction is required without precomputation, or when geometric features are more important than perceptual saliency.
It builds on earlier work in mesh saliency [LVJ05], adapting the concept to volumetric data.
